messages:
maya: quick heads-up — opened PR #1423 to simplify compact response examples in /docs/invoke/compact.md. Goal: remove ambiguous union wrappers that trip the parser heuristics and make the SDK snippets explicit. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1423
alex: looking now. main concern: examples that show both an envelope (tool_call) and raw JSON in the same section might confuse readers. can we add a concise 'envelope vs raw' subsection?
sasha: agree. also note the python SDK snippet uses camelCase keys in the example, but our serializer normalizes to snake_case. we should show both variants or call out normalization.
maya: good call. plan: split the snippet into two micro-examples — python (snake_case) and ts (camelCase) — and add a single parser note: "SDKs normalize keys; parsers should accept both forms."
juan: small nit from the linter: compact.md uses bracket shorthand like `items?[]` in examples — that caused the example linter to flag ambiguous arrays. i'll update to explicit empty-array `[]` or omit the field to make optional arrays clear. added a couple of test prompts in the PR to catch parse regressions.
alex: can you paste the python snippet you plan to add? i want to sanity-check the parse flow with the canonicalizer.
maya: ```python
# example: function call with structured response (snake_case)
response = client.call(
    model="redwood-small",
    input=prompt,
    functions=[{
        "name": "create_event",
        "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
                "title": {"type": "string"},
                "start_time": {"type": "string"},
                "attendees": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}
            },
            "required": ["title", "start_time"]
        }
    }],
    response_mode="structured"
)
# parser receives the structured payload as: {"title": "...", "start_time": "...", "attendees": ["a@x.com"]}
```
alex: LGTM aside from a tiny wording nit in the note. @sasha can you run the snippet-extractor on this PR? last time it dropped trailing commas in the python block and broke the snippet test.
sasha: on it — running extractor + snippet-tests now. will also add a unit in snippets repo to assert that both the envelope form (`{"tool_call": {...}}`) and the raw form parse to the same internal shape. ETA EOD.
docs-bot: Deploy preview published for PR #1423: https://deploy-preview-1423--redwood-docs.netlify.app/docs/invoke/compact.html (preview expires in 7 days)
maya: :thumbsup: merging after sasha's tests pass. i'll also add a short migration note in /docs/migration/function-calling.md calling out the removal of the ambiguous union examples and linking both the envelope vs raw subsection.
